{{Quote|Excuse me, can you tell me how to get to the Imperial Message Center?''"<br />"''Sure. But you don't want to go there.|An individual asks for directions to the Imperial Message Center|<ref name="RPG" />}}
The '''Imperial Message Center''' was a communication center. It was located on [[Imperium]], which was three blocks away from [[Palpatine Boulevard]]. An individual once asked for directions to the Imperial Message Center, and was given the directions via Palpatine Boulevard and Imperium.<ref name="RPG" />
